reconnecting.title: Live updates paused.
reconnecting.description: This page stopped receiving changes made by others, so what you see may be out of date. Reconnecting now; this message goes away once live updates are back.
reconnecting.stillFailing: Still not connected. Check this device's internet connection, then press Reconnect.

offline.title: You're offline.
offline.description: This device lost its internet connection. Pages show what was loaded before, and changes cannot be saved. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data; this message goes away when you're back online.

sessionEnded.title: Live updates stopped.
sessionEnded.description: Your sign-in ended, so this page no longer receives changes made by others. Sign in again, or press Reconnect. Live updates start again once you're signed in.

reconnectTitle: Connect to live updates now instead of waiting

indicator.sessionEnded: Live updates stopped: sign in again
indicator.impersonationEnded: Live updates ended with the view-as session
indicator.idle: No live data on this page

stopped.title: Live updates stopped.
stopped.description: The server closed the live connection and will not reopen it by itself, so this page no longer receives changes made by others. Press Reconnect; if it stops again, reload the page.

impersonationEnded.title: Live updates ended.
impersonationEnded.description: This view-as session is over, so this tab no longer receives changes. Close this tab; live updates do not restart here.

announce.sessionEnded: Live updates stopped: sign in again.
announce.impersonationEnded: Live updates ended with the view-as session.
